hero.title: BBA in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) is an undergraduate business degree that prepares students to develop skills in management, marketing, finance, entrepreneurship, human resources and business operations. **BBA in Mauritius** is an option for students interested in pursuing undergraduate business education in an international learning environment. Mauritius offers undergraduate business and management programs through institutions that prepare students for careers in companies, financial services, consulting and entrepreneurship.

overview: Not all universities in Mauritius offer a degree called BBA. Other similar options are Middlesex University Mauritius BA (Hons) Business Management and Open University of Mauritius BSc (Hons) Business Management. Before applying students should check the qualification title. Students exploring a **Bachelor of Business Administration in Mauritius** should compare these related qualifications and confirm the exact degree awarded by the institution.

faq.question: Is BBA degree accessible in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Some institutions in Mauritius do offer undergraduate business and management programs but some institutions offer the BA (Hons) Business Management or BSc (Hons) Business Management instead of BBA. Students should check with the institution for the exact title of the award. Those researching BBA in Mauritius should not assume that a related business management degree has the same qualification title.

faq.question: How long is BBA in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Many full-time undergraduate business degrees are 3 years long. Middlesex University Mauritius lists three years for its BA (Hons) Business Management while Open University of Mauritius lists three to six years for its Bsc (Hons) Business Management.

faq.question: What is the cost of BBA in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Middlesex University Mauritius charges international students £5,800 for related business degrees, while the Open University of Mauritius charges international non-SADC students US\$6,840 for the full BSc (Hons) Business Management.

faq.question: Can Indian students do BBA in Mauritius after 12th?
faq.answer: Yes, Indian students can apply to study abroad if they meet the entry requirements of their chosen institution. They should look at how their Class 12 qualification is assessed, whether English-language evidence is needed and what international tuition and study-permit conditions apply.

faq.question: What can I do after BBA?
faq.answer: Graduates might consider an MBA, MSc Management, MSc International Business Management or a specialist master’s in finance, marketing or human resources. Entry requirements vary by course and institution.
